about.title: About Us
about.tagline: Helping you find great food across Bangladesh.
about.metaDescription: Learn about KhaoBD — a restaurant discovery platform helping people across Bangladesh find great places to eat.
about.missionBody: KhaoBD was built to make it easy to discover good restaurants across Bangladesh — from well-known spots in Dhaka to hidden gems in Chittagong and Sylhet. We believe finding a great meal shouldn't depend on word of mouth alone.
about.offer1: Browse restaurants by area, cuisine, and price range
about.offer2: Real reviews and ratings from diners like you
about.offer3: Menus with photos so you know what to expect before you go
about.offer4: A bilingual experience in English and Bangla
